config.scenarios: data/scenarios/scenarios.json (bases mined from dev-seed scripted matches; one-flip variants)

giant.reasoning_main: off (the giant's fastest configuration; conservative for the speed claim)

config.scoring: top-1 on unambiguous scenarios; regret = best mean - chosen mean on all scenarios; fallbacks counted, not scored; context sensitivity: per family, pairs (base, variant) where the key's best differs and the variant is unambiguous; a pair is correct when the decider changed its pick and the new pick is worth more in the variant than its base pick (or above the variant's mean option value when the base pick is not offered); a family counts when at least half its pairs are correct
config.simplified: options are a curated 6-8 option subset of the full mask (fixed rule in curateOptions); the scripted baseline is basic_cycle applied to the scenario view
